principle.name: Minimal dependency
principle.description: Hanya gunakan library yg benar-benar diperlukan
principle.rationale: Skrip scraping harus portabel & gampang di-install di lingkungan berbeda

example.bad: puppeteer + playwright + cheerio + axios + got + request (overkill)

principle.name: Modular architecture
principle.description: Pisahkan HTTP client, parser, dan transformer
principle.rationale: Memudahkan debugging, testing, dan reuse komponen

principle.name: Stealth & anti-detection
principle.description: Mimikri browser real untuk hindari blocking
principle.rationale: Banyak site block request yg kelihatan bot

example.good: Rotate User-Agent, set Referer, gunakan header lengkap, delay antar request
example.bad: Default axios headers tanpa User-Agent, request tanpa delay, concurrency tinggi

principle.name: Error resilience
principle.description: Skrip harus survive dari error network, timeout, rate limit
principle.rationale: Scraping real-world selalu ada error — harus handle gracefully

convention.rule: Nama function harus deskriptif: fetchDetail, parseEpisodeList, extractDownloadUrl
Constanta gunakan UPPER_SNAKE: BASE_URL, USER_AGENT, HEADERS
Helper/pure functions dipisah ke file terpisah jika reusable
Selalu set User-Agent yg valid & realistis

pitfall.why_problematic: Token & cookies punya masa berlaku — skrip akan broken setelah expired
pitfall.correct_approach: Implement login/session refresh flow, atau ambil cookie dinamis via init request

pitfall.why_problematic: Request terlalu cepat → kena block/ban IP
pitfall.correct_approach: Implement delay antar request, gunakan queue system untuk concurrency

pitfall.why_problematic: Website bisa update layout — scraper broken tiba-tiba
pitfall.correct_approach: Gunakan selector yg resilient (data-attributes, ID), dokumentasi asumsi struktur HTML

pitfall.why_problematic: Beberapa site redirect bot ke halaman captcha/block
pitfall.correct_approach: Set maxRedirects, inspect final URL, handle redirect manually jika perlu

category.name: before_development
category.item: Inspeksi target via DevTools / curl — pahami struktur
Cek robots.txt & Terms of Service (ethical scraping)

category.name: during_development
category.item: Gunakan helper modular — jangan satu function raksasa
Sertakan error handling untuk setiap request

category.name: before_completion
category.item: Test dengan real endpoint — verifikasi output
Test edge cases (404, redirect, empty result)
Pastikan bisa di-install & di-run di environment berbeda
